scripts.build: bun build --compile src/index.tsx --outfile dist/anvil && bun build --compile src/cli/index.ts --outfile dist/anvil-cli
scripts.build:install: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/anvil ~/.local/bin/anvil && cp dist/anvil-cli ~/.local/bin/anvil-cli && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/anvil ~/.local/bin/anvil-cli
